surface.purpose: Every box, rail list, nav bar and tab strip.

surface-head.purpose: Box header strips and the hover fill for rows and outlined actions.

muted.purpose: Secondary lines, column headers, rail headings, inactive tabs, dates.

link.purpose: Link text and blue status words; lightens in dark mode.

link-fill.purpose: Filled primary actions, tags, pills, bars, underlines. No dark override: theme-invariant under white text.

gold.purpose: Achievement badge, selected screenshot ring, featured fact bullets. Theme-invariant.

win.purpose: Live status word, dot, row edge, availability line.

idle.purpose: Archived row edge, hollow past-stack marker, scrollbar thumb. Never running text.

panel.purpose: Photo panel, screenshot stage, social icon buttons, code blocks, footer.

track.purpose: Unfilled stat-bar track and loading skeletons.

display.purpose: Profile handle; 26px below sm, 28px from sm.

headline.purpose: Post article title; 28px below sm, 32px from sm, text-wrap balance.

title.purpose: Box header titles and experience company names.

body.purpose: Working size for rows, tables, lists, tabs, nav, buttons. Weights 400/600/700.

body-small.purpose: Dates, context lines, column headers, badges, header asides.

label.purpose: Uppercase muted rail section headings and the featured stack sub-heading; the heading of its list, never an eyebrow above another heading.

narrative.overview:
The site is a pro player profile page, translated to a developer career: an identity table, team history, achievement badges, stats bars and a ledger of recent "matches" (projects). It is dense and factual. Information sits in white boxes with pale header strips on a gray-blue ground, set in small Open Sans with tabular numerals, the way a stats site reads rather than the way a marketing page sells. The reader skims rows, not hero copy.

Personality lives in the details (the trophy-shelf milestone row, the gold highlight badges, status edges on project rows, a flag on the photo panel), never in effects. Depth is structural: borders, header strips and a dark panel behind imagery; there are no shadows, no glows, no gradients. Light and dark are the same structure: the dark theme swaps the ground and boxes to slate while the filled blue and gold stay constant. The confirmed anti-reference is the generic dark-neon developer portfolio (glow, particles, card grid).
keyCharacteristics: Boxes, not cards: square, 1px ruled, header strip on top, flat.
Small and dense: 13px body, 15px box titles, 11px uppercase rail headings.
One blue doing two jobs: link text, and filled primary actions and markers.
Status is a colored edge plus a colored word, never a colored card.

rules.name: The Two-Blues Rule
rules.body: Blue text uses `link`, which lightens in dark mode; blue fills use `link-fill`, which never changes. Never put white text on `link`.

rules.name: The Gold-Is-Earned Rule
rules.body: Gold marks an achievement or the current selection of an achievement-adjacent element. It is never a generic accent or a button.

rules.name: The Status-Edge Rule
rules.body: Project status is a 3px edge on the row plus a colored status word: green live, blue open source, gray shipped/archived. The direction contract named red for a status edge; the build ships blue for open source and no red, and the build is authoritative.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy inside a box comes from weight (700 label vs 400 value) and color (ink vs muted), not from new sizes. Stay on the 11 / 12 / 13 / 15 px steps inside boxes.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals are tabular everywhere; do not switch to proportional figures for "nicer" prose numbers.

rules.name: The Rail Rule
rules.body: Rails are bare stacks: an 11px uppercase muted heading, then a single ruled list box. No header strip on rail lists.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Never add a box-shadow, glow or gradient to separate content. If something needs separation, it gets a rule, a strip, or the panel.

dos: Do put every content group in a square Box: 1px hairline border, Header Strip title bar at 15px bold.
Do keep body copy at 13px with weight and muted color carrying hierarchy.
Do reserve filled Ledger Blue buttons for primary actions (Download CV, Open the demo, All repositories) and use outlined buttons for everything else.
Do use `link` for blue text and `link-fill` for blue fills so both themes stay legible.
Do mark project status with a 3px row edge plus a colored word: green live, blue open source, gray shipped.
Do use gold only for achievements, with on-gold ink.
Do design every surface in both light and dark, and in both en and pt-BR.
Do honor reduced motion: one-shot fills and color transitions only, with animation removed under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows, gradients or particle effects; the dark-neon developer portfolio is the anti-reference.
Don't round box, button, badge or tab corners; full rounding is only for status dots and count pills.
Don't put white text on gold or on the text-role `link` blue.
Don't use a filled blue button for a secondary action.
Don't use Idle Gray for running text; it is for edges and markers.
